content.title: Dynamic Bronchoscopic Evolution of a Cobblestone-like Appearance in COVID-19-associated Pulmonary Aspergillosis: A Case Report.
content.abstract: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19)-associated pulmonary aspergillosis (CAPA) is associated with high mortality and diagnostic difficulties. We report a fatal case of CAPA with a distinctive cobblestone-like tracheobronchial appearance observed during bronchoscopy. A patient receiving maintenance hemodialysis for chronic kidney disease was admitted with severe COVID-19. Bronchoscopy revealed multiple white tracheobronchial plaques, suggestive of an invasive Aspergillus infection. Despite antifungal therapy, respiratory failure progressed, and repeat bronchoscopy revealed worsening cobblestone-like lesions. The patient died despite receiving intensive treatment. Autopsy confirmed Aspergillus hyphal invasion, corresponding to the bronchoscopic findings, highlighting a rare but diagnostically important airway manifestation of CAPA.
